# Ap-Tourism
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<title>Andhra Pradesh Tourism</title>
<style>
 body {
        margin: 0;
        font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
        background-image: url("https://www.fabhotels.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/600x400-42.jpg");        
        background-repeat:no-repeat ;
        height: 160vh;
        background-size: cover;
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
    }
    .tourism-container {
        text-align: center;
        padding: 20px;
        color: white;
    }
  
    .title {
        font-size: 5em;
        margin: 20px 0 10px;
        font-weight: bold;
    }
    .subtitle {
        font-size: 2em;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        color: white;
        font-weight: bold;
    }
    .btn {
        background-color: #22b8cf;
        border: none;
        color: white;
        padding: 12px 30px;
        font-size: 16px;
        border-radius: 25px;
        cursor: pointer;
        text-decoration: none;
        display: inline-block;
    }
    .btn:hover {
        background-color: #1999ad;
    }

    .places-container {
        display: none;
        padding: 20px;
    }
    h1 {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .place-card {
        background: white;
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 15px;
        margin: 15px auto;
        max-width: 700px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }
    .place-card img {
        width: 90px;
        height: 70px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        object-fit: cover;
        margin-left: 10px;
    }
    .place-text {
        max-width: 550px;
    }
    .place-text h2 {
        margin: 0 0 8px;
        color: #0d47a1;
    }
    .place-text p {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 0.95em;
        color: #444;
    }
    .back-btn {
        display: block;
        margin: 20px auto;
        background: #333;
        color: #fff;
        padding: 10px 25px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 8px;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    .back-btn:hover {
        background: #111;
    }
</style>
<link rel="stylesheets" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>

<div class="tourism-container" id="home">
    <div class="title">Tourism</div>
    <div class="subtitle">Lets Go To Andhra Pradesh.</div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showPlaces()">LET'S GO</button>
</div>

<div class="places-container" id="places">
    <h1>Andhra Pradesh famous Places</h1>

    <div class="place-card">
        <div class="place-text">
            <h2>VIZAG</h2>
            <p>Vizag offers tourists stunning beaches, a serene landscape, a rich cultural past, and a major port, providing a picturesque coastal vacation experience in South India.</p>
        </div>
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
    </div>

    <div class="place-card">
        <div class="place-text">
            <h2>Ramanarayanam Temple</h2>
            <p>The entire Temple is designed in the shape of a bow and arrow—symbolic of Lord Rama.</p>
        </div>
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
    </div>

    <div class="place-card">
        <div class="place-text">
            <h2>Tirumala</h2>
            <p>Govinda... Govinda! Chanting His name once with devotion is enough to wash away lifetimes of sins.</p>
        </div>
        <img src="https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSDqwyNj352iUqQwBuhPcWtXIF0SoqmqQsESQ&s">
    </div>

    <div class="place-card">
        <div class="place-text">
            <h2>Vijayawada</h2>
            <p>"The Place of Victory" and also known as Bezawada. It has a rich mythological and historical background, attracting tourists with its blend of ancient monuments and modern infrastructure.</p>
        </div>
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
    </div>

    <button class="back-btn" onclick="goBack()">Back</button>
</div>

<script>
    function showPlaces() {
        document.getElementById('home').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('places').style.display = 'block';
    }
    function goBack() {
        document.getElementById('places').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('home').style.display = 'block';
    }
</script>

</body>
</html>
